snippet.title: White Ward // Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4516830/White_Ward/

You Are Trapped In A Endless White Hospital Ward. The Nurse Asks You To Wait Patiently, But Something Tells You That Is A Bad Idea. Examine Each Ward Carefully To Escape The White Ward.

Developed by
Caleb Breithaupt
